description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeesStudioModule class, a subclass of StudioModule, which provides specialized behavior related to subpanels and module relationships within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: EmployeesStudioModule
classes.description: A class extending StudioModule that overrides methods to customize subpanel support and relationship management for the Employees module.

methods.name: getProvidedSubpanels
methods.description: Returns false to indicate no subpanels are provided for this module, preventing other modules from relating to Employees.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the list of related modules from the parent, then removes the 'Relationships' entry if present, customizing the module linkage.
